entries.title: Fabledom

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Fabledom is available on PC and later came to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch. There is no platform-exclusive gameplay content, so the PC version is the best archive route for fidelity, settings, and capture while console versions remain convenience options.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release on Steam. Use console versions only if couch/portable play is the goal.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition exists.
